title: Deductible Election Form, CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy
content:
The named insured of a CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy may elect to raise the policy's per-occurrence deductible midterm by signing a deductible election, which returns premium for the rest of the term.

## Conditions of the election

1. A deductible raise takes effect on the day the named insured requests it, and that day is before the expiration date.
2. The credit for a deductible raise is worked out only after the declarations show Coverage A at or above the tier's minimum for the master policy type on file.

Stated the other way round, while the declarations show Coverage A below the tier's minimum for the master policy type on file, the credit for a deductible raise is not worked out.

## What signing records

Signing records the deductible endorsement, with the new deductible, its full-year premium effect and the premium credited for the rest of the term, marked as return premium. It sets the deductible shown on the declarations to the new amount and posts the credit as a pro-rata return-premium entry on the policy's premium account, lowering the amount owed by that credit. On success the declarations show the new deductible and the premium account shows the credit, effective the day of signing.

## Signing: the tool

`elect_deductible_raise_c9f31846` is the named insured's own tool. The representative unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it to sign the election (`call_user_discoverable_tool`).

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `condo_policy_id` | the reference number of the insured's own CondoGuard policy, as the service representative reads it out from the policy record | reference number, text |
| `deductible` | the new per-occurrence deductible the insured elects | USD, 2 decimal places, stored exactly as passed |
| `annual_premium_change` | the full-year premium reduction of the higher deductible, as the representative quotes it | USD, 2 decimal places, a positive amount, rounded half-up to the cent when stored |
| `prorated_premium` | the premium credited for the rest of the current term, as the representative quotes it | USD, 2 decimal places, a positive amount, rounded half-up to the cent when stored and posted as the return-premium credit |

## Receipt

On success the tool returns `status` `deductible_raised`, with `endorsement_id` (reference number of the new endorsement entry), `billing_id` (reference number of the return-premium entry), `condo_policy_id` (the policy endorsed), `deductible` (the deductible now on the declarations, USD), `effective_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `prorated_premium` (the credit posted, USD).
